en: The postcard depicts an old railway station with wooden panel walls and a red, gabled roof. In front of the building, several people, including railway workers and a woman with children, are gathered on the platform, and a bicycle is leaning against a fence to the left. There is a tall mechanical signal pole near the building, and trees surround the station. The text at the top reads 'Gagnef. Djurås station.' and above the door the sign says 'DJURAS'.
